column3: The US supreme court has allowed Donald Trump to continue his administration’s construction of a border wall in Texas’s Big Bend region. (美國最高法院已允許唐納·川普繼續其政府在德州大彎曲地區的邊境圍牆興建工程。)

The nation’s highest court granted the Trump administration’s emergency request to suspend a lower court order that had temporarily stopped the project last month. (美國最高法院批准了川普政府的緊急請求，暫停了一項上個月曾暫時停止該計畫的下級法院命令。)
The head of the world’s most valuable chip company faces an internal investigation over a romantic relationship with an alleged Chinese spy. (這家全球最有價值的晶片公司負責人正面臨一項內部調查，起因是與一名疑似中國間諜的浪漫關係。)
Donald Trump, Elon Musk and prominent finance moguls have expressed their support for embattled Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. (唐納·川普、伊隆·馬斯克和傑出的金融大亨們已表達了對陷入困境的輝達執行長黃仁勳的支持。)
France accuses Iran of cyber 'sabotage' in fridge attacks. (法國指控伊朗在冰箱攻擊事件中進行網路「破壞」。)

France says Iranian military hackers took over refrigeration controllers at around 700 different retail sites last month, spoiling millions of dollars' worth of food. (法國表示伊朗軍方駭客上個月接管了約 700 個不同零售點的冷藏控制器，導致價值數百萬美元的食物損壞。)
Adoration for the US tech giant’s CEO Jensen Huang has been labelled “Jensanity”, but can his reputation survive the news of his affair? (對這家美國科技巨頭執行長黃仁勳的崇拜被稱為「黃仁勳狂熱」，但他的名聲能挺過這則婚外情新聞嗎？)

British comedian Russell Brand sentenced to over 10 years for rape and sexual assault. (英國喜劇演員羅素·布蘭德因強姦和性侵被判處超過 10 年徒刑。)

Russell Brand, who became a celebrity darling in the early 2000s, was found guilty on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault in a case brought by six women. (在 2000 年代初期成為名人寵兒的羅素·布蘭德，在六名女性提起的訴訟中，被判一項強姦罪和三項性侵罪成立。)
